name: std/drivers
description: Low-level device drivers: display registry, serial ports (V24), keyboard/mouse, PC speaker, clipboard.
residual: The modules under `graphical` belong to this package but cannot travel in the headless SDK: their own import closure reaches the window system. The list is checked against the import graph by docker/gen-headless-core.sh, so it cannot go quietly out of date.
Library cores (Displays, Serials) resolve to std/runtime only. The rest are thin device shims.
WARNING: Beep is intentionally NOT included — Unix Beep imports X11/Displays (see the DataErrors fix). If a real cross-platform PC-speaker driver is wanted it needs a headless backend first.
App/tool members of the driver family (BootManager, HotKeys, CPUID, V24Tracer, TVDriver, VfW, WSock32) are commands/apps -> packages/apps, not this library.
